**Answer: Jürgen Aschoff studied medicine at the University of Bonn.**

- He studied medicine at the University of Bonn, then moved to the University of Göttingen, where his scientific career began. This comes from the Nature obituary by Daan and Gwinner. https://www.nature.com/articles/24750
- After the Abitur, he studied medicine at the University of Bonn, "lacking a specific interest" by his own account. Wikipedia gives this and lists Bonn as his education. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%BCrgen_Aschoff
- Wikipedia also cites the Nature obituary as a source for its biography section. That means the two sources are not fully independent. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%BCrgen_Aschoff

A search-result snippet said Wikidata lists Heidelberg and Freiburg as places he was educated. I did not open the Wikidata page. Nothing I read contradicts Bonn as the place he studied medicine. He later worked in Göttingen, Würzburg and Heidelberg.

Sources:
- https://www.nature.com/articles/24750
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%BCrgen_Aschoff
